svg.title: Probability of detection against time on task
svg.desc: Four curves for a 2,000 square nautical mile box at 80 knots: a scanned gimbal with sweep width 2 NM, a search sensor with sweep width 4 NM under random and parallel search, and an assumed 3,000 square nautical miles per hour wide-area layer.
svg.text: ASSUMPTIONS box 2,000 NM² · 80 kt · sweep widths assumed for one target and sea state
